## NotesClient interface

The Notes client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `notesContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [NotesResources](./notes_contract.notesresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface NotesClient extends ClientBrand<NotesResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[NotesResources](./notes_contract.notesresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
